Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver

Class JnlpSecurityManager

java.lang.Object
java.lang.SecurityManager
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.JnlpSecurityManager
public class JnlpSecurityManager extends SecurityManager
Simple Security Manager for JNLP deployment. Asks user for permission to write to a file. Logs all read and write accesses.
